section_summary.extract_value: This section presents between-group comparisons of body appreciation scores using the BAS-2 instrument. Men (M = 3.59) had significantly higher body appreciation than women (M = 3.48), though the effect size was small (d = 0.19). The section also compares the present study's findings to Study 3 from Tylka and Wood-Barcalow (2015b), showing that both women and men in the present study reported higher body appreciation than their counterparts in the prior community sample.
